Definition: open country, village life (also concretely, the inhabitants of unwalled villages)
BiblicalUsage: Perazon is the open country, the village life of Israel. Deborah sang that the inhabitants of the villages ceased until she arose, a mother in Israel, and that in the places of drawing water they rehearsed the righteous acts of the LORD toward His villages.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that village life is where God's righteous acts are rehearsed: at the well, not only at the altar.
